findings.description: `/b.txt` with `Host: beta.test` is 200 `beta` while `Host: alpha.test` is 404, proving the vhost root is live — but on `/al/x.txt` both hosts return MARKER-ALIASDIR-x.txt. S14 shows `/al../alpha/x.txt` from the beta host reading the alpha root, so the escape crosses roots, not just directories.
findings.title: The alias branch overwrites the vhost-selected root after host validation, so a vhost choice is discarded on any alias path
